systems.tiers: Government network serving ministries, departments and agencies; the project plans technical assistance to optimise, upgrade and expand it and to upgrade its network operations centre into a larger, secure, dedicated government network; no commune or other local government office is said to be on it

note: Passages only. The government network COMGOV is a backbone-class system with no local government office placed on it, so it gives no fact; local government appears otherwise only as a partner for the project's outreach and communication activities, and communes as places targeted by rural coverage, device and digital literacy schemes. A footnote counts 116 rural communes out of 119.
